meta.write: field occupation as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. Occupation is a number on a path. If the path never leaves CONC, the clock did not do the bound.

lemmas.name: B29_clock_readable
lemmas.statement: path clock, full CONC occupation, and visc-owned X are readable together
lemmas.why: τ_C = T. Zero switches. X falls by viscosity. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B29a_stay_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: occupying 3-CONC for the whole interval closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Both paths stay CONC and X falls. Leray’s dissipation did the work. The clock did not leave. That is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B29b_full_occ_not_short
lemmas.statement: τ_C = T on these paths is a short CONC visit that bounds X
lemmas.why: B18c already missed. B8a’s collapsing hot time is a packet ODE at high j*. These fields occupied the whole interval.

lemmas.name: B29c_occ_not_live_cubic
lemmas.statement: occupation of CONC is occupation of a live cubic
lemmas.why: Zero live samples. |P|/D stays below 0.05. Occupation of a hat is not occupation of the cubic.

lemmas.name: B29d_clock_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: τ_C = T is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A clock column is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. Full occupation of a decaying packet is not the max criterion.

lemmas.name: B29e_glue_leftover
lemmas.statement: matching the two-regime sketch closes X
lemmas.why: Scored as B19e / B30. A wrong-sign sketch is not continuation. NS climb is not an a priori (B20e). Climb sketch is not an a priori (B21e). Finer box is not an a priori (B22e). DNS leftover is B23e. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B29f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring field occupation as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. The clock is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss. No Q1. No ε.
